caption: Sunlight filters through apple trees, casting dappled shadows over grass and fallen red apples scattered across the orchard floor, with tree trunks visible on the right and a partial leg on the left.
notes: A grassy orchard floor scattered with fallen red apples under late sun, with tree trunks and dappled shadows in the background.
